cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: Cookies are small files stored on your device. We use them to keep the website working, improve performance, and support marketing and recommendations.

essential.title: Essential
essential.description: Needed for core features like sign-in, security, and keeping the site stable.

analytics.title: Analytics & preferences
analytics.description: Help us understand what's working, fix issues, and remember preferences (where available).

session.title: Session vs persistent cookies
session.description: Some cookies expire when you close your browser (session cookies). Others remain for a longer period (persistent cookies) to remember preferences or support analytics.

thirdParty.title: Third-party cookies
thirdParty.description: Some third parties (for example, payment providers or embedded services) may set cookies through our site. Those cookies are controlled by the third party.

managing.title: Managing cookies
managing.description: You can control cookies in your browser settings (block, delete, or limit). Blocking essential cookies may prevent sign-in or checkout from working correctly.

marketing.title: Marketing & recommendations
marketing.description: Some cookies may be used to measure which pages are popular, how users navigate the site, and to support better recommendations (for example, showing items similar to what you viewed).

doNotTrack.title: Do Not Track
doNotTrack.description: Some browsers offer a "Do Not Track" setting. There is no single industry standard for how sites respond, so our response may vary depending on the tools in use.

related.title: Related policies
related.description: For more details on how we use information, see our

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.description: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. We will update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Elite Coffee ("we", "us") collects and uses information when you use our website and ordering experience in Egypt.

recommendations.label: To improve recommendations
recommendations.description: and personalize the experience (marketing and better suggestions).

legal.title: Legal basis (general)
legal.description: We process information to perform our services (processing orders), to comply with legal obligations where applicable, and for legitimate business interests such as security, preventing fraud, improving performance, and improving customer experience.

processing.title: Payment processing
processing.description: Online payments are processed by our payment provider (e.g. Paymob). We don't store your full card details on our servers.

delivery.title: Delivery partners
delivery.description: If delivery is fulfilled by third parties, we share only the information needed to deliver your order (name, phone, address, order contents).

marketing.title: Marketing & recommendations
marketing.description: We may use purchase history and on-site interactions to improve menu recommendations and marketing (e.g., suggesting items you may like).
marketing.optOut: You can opt out of marketing messages by following the unsubscribe instructions (when available) or by contacting us.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: We use cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, remember preferences, and measure performance. See our

retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: We keep information only as long as needed for operations, support, security, accounting, and legal compliance, then delete or anonymize it where possible.

security.title: Security
security.description: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect information. No system is 100% secure; please keep your account access secure.

children.title: Children's privacy
children.description: Our ordering service is intended for general audiences. If you believe a child has provided personal data through our site, contact us and we will take appropriate steps.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.updateAddresses: You can update delivery addresses and phone numbers in your account settings.
choices.manageCookies: You can choose whether to accept cookies in your browser settings.
choices.accessRequest: You can contact us to request access/correction of your information.

changes.title: Changes to this policy

contact.disclaimer: This policy is provided for transparency and operational clarity. If you need formal legal advice for Egypt, consult a qualified lawyer.

acceptable.description: Don't misuse the site (fraud, abuse, automated scraping, or interfering with normal operation). We may suspend access if needed for security.
